results.title: Phone Backup
results.snippet:
Phone Backup helps you securely back up and restore your Contacts, SMS messages, and Call Logs. Store your backups on Google Drive and restore them whenever you switch devices, reset your phone, or need to recover important data.

Key Features

✓ Backup Contacts to Google Drive

✓ Restore Contacts from backup files

✓ Backup SMS messages

✓ Restore SMS messages

✓ Backup Call Logs

✓ Restore Call Logs

✓ Secure cloud storage through your own Google Drive account

✓ Manage and organize backup files easily

How It Works

1. Sign in with your Google account.
2. Choose the data you want to back up.
3. Save the backup securely to your Google Drive.
4. Restore your data whenever needed.

Permissions Used

* Contacts Permission – Required to back up and restore contacts.

* SMS Permission – Required to back up and restore SMS messages.

* Call Log Permission – Required to back up and restore call history.

* Notification Permission – Used to display backup and restore progress notifications on supported Android versions.

Privacy & Security

Your data remains under your control. Backup files are stored in your device storage or your personal Google Drive account. Phone Backup does not sell, share, or use your personal data for advertising purposes.

results.title: Swift Backup
results.snippet:
Keep the parts of your Android setup that matter.

Restore them when you switch phones, reset your device or need an earlier backup. Swift Backup gives you one place to manage local, cloud and self-hosted backups without locking you into a single storage provider.

What you can back up
• Apps and APKs
• App data and selected app settings on rooted devices
• Messages and call logs
• Folders and files
• Applied wallpapers
• Saved Wi-Fi networks with Root or Shizuku on supported Android versions

Store backups your way
Save backups on internal storage, an SD card or USB drive where supported.

Connect Swift Backup to:
• Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and Box
• Mega.nz, pCloud, Filen, Yandex.Disk and Cloud Mail.Ru
• WebDAV, including Nextcloud, ownCloud and compatible NAS devices
• S3-compatible storage
• SMB, SFTP, FTP, FTPS and FTPES servers

Designed for real backup workflows
• Create device and cloud backups
• Restore individual APKs manually without root
• Use Root or Shizuku for supported batch operations
• Keep multiple app backup versions, add notes and protect important backups
• Schedule recurring backups to device storage or a connected cloud account
• Group apps with labels and apply custom backup and restore configurations
• Use incremental folder backups to store changed files efficiently
• Search apps, share APKs and manage backups from one clear home screen

Root and Shizuku
Root is not required to back up APKs, messages, call logs, folders or wallpapers.

Backing up and restoring private app data requires root. Some protected app files and batch restore actions require Root or Shizuku, depending on your Android version. See the FAQ for exact requirements.

Premium features
• Cloud backups for apps and folders
• Scheduled backups
• Backup history, notes and protected backups
• App labels
• Custom app backup and restore configurations

Sign-in and encryption
You can use Swift Backup anonymously and offline for local backups. Google Sign-in is required for cloud backups and Premium features. Browser-based sign-in is available on devices without Google Play services.

Backups are encrypted, except APKs, expansion files and wallpapers. Backups are tied to the Swift Backup account used to create them, so use the same account when moving to another device.

Learn more
• FAQ: www.swiftapps.org/faq
• Common issues: www.swiftapps.org/issues
• Email: support@swiftapps.org
• Telegram: https://t.me/swiftbackupsupport

results.title: SMS Backup & Restore
results.snippet:
SMS Backup & Restore is an app that backs up (creates a copy of) SMS & MMS messages and call logs currently available on the phone. It can also restore messages and call logs from already existing backups.

Note: This app requires existing backups to be able to restore call logs and messages. It cannot recover anything without existing backups.

To view the contents of the backups, visit https://www.synctech.com.au/view-backup/

For questions or issues please visit our FAQ at: https://synctech.com.au/sms-faqs/


APP FEATURES:
- Backup SMS (text) messages, MMS and call logs in XML format.
- Local device backup with options to automatically upload to Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive.
- Choose a recurring scheduled time to automatically backup.
- Option to select which conversations to backup or restore.
- View and drill into your local and cloud backups.
- Search backups.
- Restore/transfer backup to another phone. Backup format is independent of the Android version so the messages and logs can be easily transferred from one phone to another, irrespective of the version.
- Fast Transfer between 2 phones over WiFi direct
- Free up space on your phone. Delete all SMS messages or call logs on the Phone.
- Email a backup file.
- The XML backup can be viewed on a computer via the online viewer at https://SyncTech.com.au/view-backup/

Notes:
- Tested on Android 5.0 and higher
- App only restores backups made by this app
- Backup is created locally on the phone by default, but has options to upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or Email. At no time are the files sent to the developer.
- Please ensure there is a copy of the backup outside the phone before performing a factory reset on the phone.

This App needs access to the following:
* Your messages: Backup and Restore messages. Receive SMS permission needed to properly handle messages received while the app is the default messaging app.
* Your Calls and Contact information: Backup and Restore Call Logs.
* Storage: To create the Backup file on the SD card.
* Network view and communication: Allows the app to connect to wifi for backup
* Your social information: To display and store the contact names in the Backup file.
* Run at start-up: Start scheduled Backups.
* Prevent Phone from Sleeping: To prevent the phone from going to sleep/suspended state while a Backup or Restore operation is in progress.
* Test access to Protected Storage: To create the Backup file on the SD card.
* Account Information: To authenticate with Google Drive and Gmail for cloud uploads.
* Location: Only requested and used during WiFi direct transfer due to a security requirement on Android.

results.title: Autosync - File Sync & Backup
results.snippet:
Please note: This is a trial version. When the trial period expires, you will be requested to purchase to continue using the app.

Autosync is an automatic file sync and backup tool. You choose which folder in your device should be synced with which folder in your cloud storage account, and how. Autosync will then keep files in these two folders in sync with each other, automatically and without any additional efforts from the user.

The official cloud storage apps don't have automatic sync capabilities, or only to a very limited extent. The commonly offered automatic photo upload might suffice for simple photo backup but not for keeping photos on multiple devices synchronized. If you want automatic file sync between your device and your cloud storage, you need this app.

Autosync can be configured to do automatic file sharing between your devices, to back up selected folders in your phone to your cloud storage, or to make backup copies of important document folders in your cloud storage and save them in your device for offline use. These are a few examples of what you can accomplish with automatic file sync.

All file transfers and communication between user devices and cloud storage servers are securely encrypted and do not go through our servers. Outsiders, including us, will not be able to decrypt and hence see or modify any file contents.

Supported storage services and protocols:

• Google Drive
• OneDrive
• SharePoint Online
• Dropbox
• Box
• MEGA
• Nextcloud
• ownCloud
• pCloud
• Yandex Disk
• WebDAV
• FTP
• SFTP (ssh/scp)
• LAN/SMB network drives

If your cloud storage is not on the list, please check if it supports WebDAV protocol. WebDAV is widely supported by many storage service vendors.

LAN/SMB network drives are supported by Windows/Mac/Linux computers and NAS devices. This app can sync with them via local network.

Support

• Website: https://metactrl.com/autosync/
• Email: autosync@metactrl.com (please use English)

-----
This "Autosync Universal" app supports multiple cloud storage services in a single app. Users who use only one cloud storage may prefer one of our single-cloud "Autosync for ..." apps. They are smaller, have fewer features but are simpler and easier to use than this all-in-one app.

✔️ Contacts backup - save and restore your address book anytime.
✔️ SMS backup - back up text messages (including MMS) and restore when needed.
✔️ Call logs - keep call history and restore call log history after a reset or phone switch.

✔️ local backup to device storage for quick access
✔️ SD card backup for an offline copy
✔️ backup to SD card before a factory reset or phone change

⏱️ Easy backup - Manual, selective, or auto backup

You can back up everything in one tap, or pick only the items you care about such as contacts, messages, call logs, and calendar. Turn on automatic backup scheduling to keep your data backup current without thinking about it. If a cleaner or task manager closes apps in the background, add this app to the allow list for reliable scheduled backups.

Preview backup files before restoring and delete older items to save space. This keeps your backup and restore workflow clean and under control.

📌 Before you restore

✔️ Restore works only for backups created with this app; it can't recover previously deleted data.
✔️ This is data backup and restore, not live data transfer between phones.
✔️ Photos and videos aren't included — this tool focuses on contacts backup, SMS backup, call logs, calendar, and app backup and restore.

The app may request access to SMS/MMS, contacts, calendar, call logs, and storage so backup and restore can run properly. That access is used only to generate local backup files, SD card backup files, and cloud uploads when you enable them. No root access required.
